_doc: PLAN.md 4.4, Phase 4.3. Guns and the mounts they sit on. Distances in U, angles in degrees, time in seconds. An edge gun covers edge_u of a hardpoint edge (edge_u / port_pitch ports) and its barrel sticks out length_u, which is also the space it blocks. A turret sits on a hardpoint's face, which must hold a circle of turret_radius_u. over_hull: the gun sits on top of the ship and fires over its own tiles (owner, 2026-10-26: top-mounted guns can, side-mounted can't). rate is shots per second; a shot flies at speed_u U/s on top of the ship's own velocity and goes range_u. spread_deg is [at L1, at the top level]: the random scatter either side of the aim, which narrows as the gun levels up, on a log curve (owner, 2026-10-26: accuracy comes with level). Gun XP and the other stats' level scaling arrive in 4.8; those numbers are L1.

aim._doc: A gun fires once its barrel is within fire_within_deg of its aim. A fixed gun on auto fires when a target's lead point is that close to straight ahead.
